note: Open-weight models for the local AI mentor. GGUF entries are downloaded with install-ai-models.sh and verified by SHA-256 (values carried over from the MacGyver v11 manifest). Ollama entries are pulled by Ollama, which verifies its own manifests. No weights are bundled; medical answers always remain educational and must be checked against sources.

models.label: Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct · Q4_K_M
models.descriptionZh: 最小的多語文字模型，適合先測試整個流程；醫學推理能力有限。約 491 MB。
models.descriptionEn: Smallest multilingual text model for trying the pipeline; limited medical reasoning. About 491 MB.

models.label: Qwen3 0.6B · Q8_0
models.descriptionZh: 多語文字模型，關閉長思考以縮短等待；約 639 MB。
models.descriptionEn: Multilingual text model with long thinking disabled; about 639 MB.

models.label: Qwen3 1.7B · Q8_0（建議的 CPU 預設）
models.descriptionZh: run-ai-llamacpp.sh 的預設模型：中英文教學問答可用，約 1.83 GB，8 GB 記憶體以上。
models.descriptionEn: Default for run-ai-llamacpp.sh: usable bilingual tutoring, about 1.83 GB, 8 GB RAM or more.

models.label: Qwen3 4B · Ollama
models.descriptionZh: run-ai-ollama.sh 的預設模型；較強的醫學與中醫名詞理解，約 2.5 GB 權重。
models.descriptionEn: Default for run-ai-ollama.sh; stronger handling of medical and TCM terminology, about 2.5 GB.

models.label: Qwen3 8B · Ollama
models.descriptionZh: 更高品質的本機選項（約 5.2 GB），需 16 GB 記憶體或 GPU；MACGYVER 模式請改用 HT_OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen3:8b。
models.descriptionEn: Higher-quality local option (about 5.2 GB); needs 16 GB RAM or a GPU. Select with HT_OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen3:8b.

models.label: Gemma 3 4B · Ollama
models.descriptionZh: 多語言替代模型（約 3.3 GB）；使用前請閱讀 Gemma 授權條款。
models.descriptionEn: Multilingual alternative (about 3.3 GB); read the Gemma terms before use.
